searchText: I'm seeing a string of handful of bad blocks proposed by Reth on Hoodi. I'm seeing this on slots 1623386, 1623414, 1623436, 1623530. I don't think anything else is accepting these blocks as dora reports them as missed blocks. Lodestar logs looks as follows - ``` Oct 28 23:27:13 hoodi-host nvm-exec[250939]: Oct-28 23:27:13.416[execution] warn: Execution client is syncing oldState=SYNCED, newState=SYNCING Oct 28 23:27:13 hoodi-host nvm-exec[250939]: Oct-28 23:27:13.435[network] error: Error processing block slot=1623386, peer=16Uiu2HAm1NKTFtHgEXUwSNPUTeEpNhQp1s997ddBr5Ymr8kyGBK4, blockRoot=0xf281…799a, code=BLOCK_ERROR_EXECUTION_ERROR, execStatus=INVALID, errorMessage=mismatched block state root: got 0x9f5d614fc4e51e1c4fe5fa48f1c86fb40357bdf7e0fb71fccc79be5778d1d8d5, expected 0xe60e5814ec6f987d586da57d3454c6b98f6a6d33234f81bd2d7c22b1e660e332 Oct 28 23:27:13 hoodi-host nvm-exec[250939]: Error: BLOCK_ERROR_EXECUTION_ERROR Oct 28 23:27:13 hoodi-host nvm-exec[250939]: at verifyBlockExecutionPayload (file:///home/lodestar/lodestar/packages/beacon-node/src/chain/blocks/verifyBlocksExecutionPayloads.ts:337:25) Oct 28 23:27:13 hoodi-host nvm-exec[250939]: at processTicksAndRejections (node:internal/process/task_queues:105:5) Oct 28 23:27:13 hoodi-host nvm-exec[250939]: at verifyBlocksExecutionPayload (file:///home/lodestar/lodestar/packages/beacon-node/src/chain/blocks/verifyBlocksExecutionPayloads.ts:157:28) Oct 28 23:27:13 hoodi-host nvm-exec[250939]: at async Promise.all (index 0) Oct 28 23:27:13 hoodi-host nvm-exec[250939]: at BeaconChain.verifyBlocksInEpoch (file:///home/lodestar/lodestar/packages/beacon-node/src/chain/blocks/verifyBlock.ts:101:9) Oct 28 23:27:13 hoodi-host nvm-exec[250939]: at BeaconChain.processBlocks (file:///home/lodestar/lodestar/packages/beacon-node/src/chain/blocks/index.ts:76:7) Oct 28 23:27:13 hoodi-host nvm-exec[250939]: at JobItemQueue.runJob (file:///home/lodestar/lodestar/packages/beacon-node/src/util/queue/itemQueue.ts:102:22) ``` We saw this on our infra too. Our reth 1.8.2 node rejected the payload as well, so doesn't seem like an issue in the latest reth release Looks like the reth folks were already on it. They had a problem on the block building side of things and fixed in 1.8.3
